text:
Alicia M: hi team  planning for surrogacy support and lots of cross-border logistics. can parental leave start while I'm abroad to attend birth/visa processing? also curious about travel reimbursement + paperwork required for a foreign-born newborn.
Nadia (People Ops): congrats Alicia! short answer: yes, leave can start for the travel/birth period; we treat it like other parental leave but there are additional docs for international cases. please file the parental_leave_request form and note travel_start_date.
Ravi (Benefits): checklist for international surrogacy: birth certificate or equivalent, notarized parental order (if available), embassy passport/consular records, and proof of travel (itinerary). upload to secure hr portal. policy: company top-up applies once statutory entitlement is confirmed.
Alicia M: how strict is timing? the surrogate's clinic may shift dates last-minute. will that break our top-up/payroll?
Jordan (Payroll): Payroll uses code SURR_PAY. we can retro-adjust but prefer 72h notice before payroll cutoff to avoid manual corrections. if dates change after final cutoff we'll run a retro in the next cycle. email payroll@redwood.com ASAP after any change and cc your manager.
Ravi (Benefits): for visa delays that extend time abroad, we can extend leave under the same request but need updated documentation and manager approval for partial return/remote work. note: length of paid top-up may be capped by local statutory limits.
Nadia (People Ops): coverage ops: please assign two backups and create a 1-page "critical tasks" runbook. consider splitting handover into two 30m sessions if travel overlaps sprint deadlines. we also support phased return up to 60% for 4 weeks.
Alicia M: any travel reimbursement for partner/support person?
Ravi (Benefits): reimbursement: eligible employees can claim up to $3k for travel+legal fees for surrogacy-related travel. submit receipts via expense@redwood.com with code SURR_TRAVEL. if you need cash advance, talk to People Ops.
Alicia M: are there any tax implications on the travel reimbursement or top-up?
Jordan (Payroll): travel reimbursements for business-related travel are typically non-taxable if documented; surrogacy-related reimbursements are treated per local tax rules. we'll run a taxability check once you submit receipts.
Alicia M: great, thanks. who will reach out to help me assemble the dossier?
hr-bot: Ticket created: SURR-1785412345. Benefits rep will contact you within 2 business days.
Nadia (People Ops): I'll schedule a 20m intro call with benefits and payroll to walk through the docs and timeline. ping me here with preferred times. :calendar:
